svg.text: Current built terrain + route guide / north is up / 23 October 2026
Sampled relief, not an aerial game capture. Route lines are navigation overlays, not painted roads.

a.text: Home start / shelter to the west

svg.text: Basalt / rille: take the southern orange
branch, then cyan north through the channel.
Highlands: take the western circuit north,
then the green branch west. Return east
from the uplands to Earthrise Overlook.
